dedupe_keys.name: china building rooftop area cbra 2 5 m multi annual rooftop maps 2016 2021

description: CBRA is the first multi-year, high-resolution map of building rooftops across China, giving yearly 2.5 m rooftop masks for 2016 to 2021. It was made from Sentinel-2 imagery with super-resolution segmentation, and each single-band GeoTIFF marks rooftop pixels as 255 and background as 0, split into 215 tiles of 2.5 by 2.5 degrees named by year and corner coordinates, about 23 GB in all. The authors report an F1 score of 62.55 percent on 250,000 urban test samples and a recall of 78.94 percent on 30,000 rural samples. Coverage: all of China. Access: free from Zenodo and the Beijing Normal University download centre; described in Earth System Science Data in 2023. Licence: CC BY 4.0. Caveats: rooftop area only, with no height or use; accuracy in dense cities is moderate. Simulation uses are yearly building exposure layers and urban growth tracking for hazard models, and inputs to rooftop solar and heat studies. Related records: the CNBH-10 m building height dataset, 3D-GloBFP and the mainland China residential building stock grid.
